title: Convenience store robbery (hand-written sample, no CCTV frames yet)

witness_A.viewpoint: inside the store, near the snacks aisle, about 5 metres away
witness_A.statement: I was in the snacks aisle when a tall man in a red hoodie walked straight to the counter. He had a black cap on. He leaned over and grabbed cash from the register. The cashier, a young woman in a green uniform shirt, put her hands up. Then he ran out.

witness_B.viewpoint: outside on the pavement, looking in through the front window
witness_B.statement: It was night and the store was brightly lit so I could see in. I think he wore a blue jacket. He had a black backpack on his shoulder and he ran out the door towards the parking lot.

witness_C.viewpoint: in the parking lot, sitting in a car
witness_C.statement: A slim guy in black jeans came running out of the store. I'm pretty sure he had a knife in his hand. He ran past my car.
